statement: H100 cloud rental averages $3.58/hr per GPU across 48 tracked providers, ranging from $0.93/hr to $14.90/hr.
why: Establishes the current H100 rental price level as a market display overlay.

impact.mechanism: Rental price level is a display overlay and does not by itself move demand or supply.

evidence.excerpt: Average sits at $3.58/hr; full range $0.93/hr to $14.90/hr per GPU including spot and reserved terms.

confidence.basis: Secondary aggregator; static price level without stated baseline change.
